principle: A repository becomes CANONICAL only when its specialist position is resolved by lineage and immutable proof, not by prose or score alone.
projection_rule: Every declared projection_ref for a CANONICAL repository must expose the same repository identity, canonical head, and CANONICAL implementation state.
blocker_rule: A retained blocker may coexist with CANONICAL only when the canonical-position receipt explicitly classifies it as non-canonicalization-blocking and the earned proof/authority/projection gates remain true.
company_claim_rule: Repository CANONICAL state never advances a company claim stage or ceiling; company claim authority remains independently gated.
